BM25 filter keeps only pages relevant to the query

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"bm25_query\":\"rust programming language\",\"bm25_threshold\":0.1,\"content_filter\":\"bm25\",\"max_depth\":1}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.crawl(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.pages()[0].html())
```
